cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Hope with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into believing that the outcome can still change, even when the evidence is thin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help me choose glasses for our cafe. Hold them by the base, please; we need to see how they'll look on the tables.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're only on the waiting list. I haven't even told Mum.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Waiting isn't rejected. Please assess the glass, not the application. Picture someone sitting at our table: what would you serve them in?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum would want a mug. She hates tea in glass.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then find her a mug. Not that tiny one; she'll want to stay. Put it beside our two glasses so we can see the whole table.
